Not really a hot dog, but you can do it yourself it by mixing ground meat with a bit of ice water and spices (I like black pepper, paprika and cayenne, and not adding any salt) in a bowl, letting it chill for a few hours, then scoop a portion out on the counter and forming a sausage shape. After that you can carefully place it on the grill or a no-stick pan and cook it, turning once half way through the cooking process. Now you have meat in the perfect shape for a hot dog bun, or you can eat it solo with some BBQ veg on the side.
